headline: Egypt: Misr Life Insurance offers 15% of its capital on the stock exchange
summary: Egyptian state-owned life insurer Misr Life Insurance plans to list 15% of its capital on the Egyptian Exchange, subject to regulatory approvals and market conditions. Trading is expected to start in December.
why: The Egyptian Exchange is the country's main equity market, and state asset listings are part of Egypt's privatisation and capital-markets agenda.
original_headline: Égypte : Misr Life Insurance met 15 % de son capital en Bourse
